gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-sarpanch: Stark, structural Stencilia hits first, with compact spacing between x-height and ascenders. Sarpanch, a sans-serif with a clearly open lowercase e, makes extended reading feel approachable and contemporary, never fussy.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-schibsted-grotes: Wide gaps break every curve in Stencilia, structural and striking. Schibsted Grotesk keeps its terminals open and its e and a generous, so extended text goes down easily and feels approachable.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-sen: Low and striking, Stencilia carries its structure in compact lines and generous gaps at curve ends. And Sen brings upright lowercase and round letters whose curved walls weigh as much as the straight ones.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-sintony: Stencilia leaves generous gaps where its curves end, giving the heading a striking, structural look. Sintony adds a chunky midzone and smooth, unclogged curves, so the text underneath reads cleanly against that sharp display.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-sofia-sans: Striking, structural Stencilia sits low and compact at the top. Sofia Sans has no stroke modulation at all, just rounded letters with clearly open sides, so long reading feels modern.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-sofia-sans-semi-: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed keeps lowercase nearly level with capitals, in a line as constant as a stencil-cut channel. And Stencilia lands low and striking, a sharp counterpoint to that drawn-wire weight.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-sono: Sono runs wide in its default spacing, each lowercase a left ajar. Under striking, structural Stencilia, that generosity in the setting is what lends the combination its approachable ease across a full page of text.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads smooth and tube-like, its marker-like line weight and bulky lowercase proportions making every open letter gap easy to find. Stencilia up top keeps the paragraphs below feeling steady.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-tiktok-sans: Striking and structural, Stencilia leaves wide openings where its curves finish. TikTok Sans lifts its x-height close to the cap height and opens the c generously, keeping the text beneath easy to take in.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans draws a ruler-drawn line of constant width. Its curves end in wide, unclosed terminals and the x-height fills the line, which keeps extended text easy going beneath the striking Stencilia heading.
